overview.text:
**Changed**
- `index.js:prettyBytes` now validates `options.roundingMode` via `assertRoundingMode` and maps it with `toMagnitudeMode(roundingMode, number < 0)` [E9, H7].
- `toMagnitudeMode`: `round`→`halfExpand`; `floor`→`expand`/`trunc` (neg/pos); `ceil`→`trunc`/`expand`; `undefined`→`undefined` [H4].
- `buildLocaleOptions` passes `magnitudeMode ?? 'trunc'` to `Intl` options, so omitting it keeps truncation [E8, H6].
- With fraction digits and non-trunc mode, a pre-rounded value `>= base` moves up a unit (e.g. `999960`→`1 MB`) [E10, H8].
- Default 3-significant-digit path keeps `toPrecision` for round/undefined and uses new `roundToSignificantDigits` for floor/ceil [H8, H4].
- `toUnrepresentableString` (huge bigint) now rounds exactly using bigint remainder, not only truncation [E6, H4, H9].
- Added `roundingMode` type/docs to `index.d.ts` and `readme.md`, plus 3 `expectType` lines in `index.test-d.ts` [E28, E31, E35, H3, H13, H10].

**Why**
- User wanted round/floor/ceil working with fraction digits, `locale`, `signed`, and negatives, documented [E1].
- Default left `undefined`, not `'round'`: making it `'round'` would change existing truncated output (`59_952_784`→`'59.9 MB'`). Documented in readme [E38, H13].
- Negatives use the mathematical definition: `floor(-1999)`→`'-2 kB'`, and `-0` is preserved [H3, H13].

**Risks**
- This departs from the spec's "default 'round'". Callers must pass `'round'` explicitly to round fraction digits [E38].
- Tie behavior differs by path: `1005`→`1 kB` (default) vs `1.01 kB` (fraction digits) [H13, E36].
- `test-rounding.js` passes 11/11. Ran `test.js` through a home-made ava shim outside the repo: 48 pass, 3 skipped [E37].
- The shim's fidelity to ava is unverified. An earlier failure was the missing readme in the shim directory [E23, E24, E37].
- `tsd` and `xo` were not run [E38].
- Two Bash commands were blocked as "expansion obfuscation" and were redone via Write/Edit [E15, E34].
- One test expectation was corrected from `'999.960 kB'` to `'999.96 kB'` after it failed [E13, E14].
- The `git stash`/`stash pop` in E23 touched the worktree briefly. Untracked dotfiles in the repo are not the agent's [E23, E38].

mechanism.text:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["prettyBytes(number, options)"] --> B["assertRoundingMode(options.roundingMode)"]
    B -->|"invalid value"| X["throw TypeError"]
    B -->|"round / floor / ceil / undefined"| C["toMagnitudeMode(roundingMode, number < 0)"]
    C -->|"magnitudeMode: halfExpand / expand / trunc / undefined"| D["buildLocaleOptions(options, magnitudeMode)"]
    D -->|"no fraction digit options"| E["localeOptions = undefined"]
    D -->|"fraction digit options set"| F["localeOptions.roundingMode = magnitudeMode ?? 'trunc'"]
    E --> G{"scaled value fits in number?"}
    F --> G
    G -->|"yes, localeOptions set"| H["carry check: round via en-US toLocaleString, rounded >= base"]
    H -->|"carry"| I["number /= base; exponent += 1"]
    G -->|"yes, no localeOptions"| J{"magnitudeMode undefined or halfExpand?"}
    J -->|"yes"| K["Number(number.toPrecision(minimumPrecision))"]
    J -->|"no"| L["roundToSignificantDigits(number, digits, magnitudeMode)"]
    G -->|"no (huge bigint)"| M["toUnrepresentableString(..., magnitudeMode): bigint digits + remainder"]
    H --> N["toLocaleString(number, locale, localeOptions)"]
    I --> N
    K --> N
    L --> N
```
Diagram sources: [H4, H5, H6, H7, H8, H9].

- **Validation.** `assertRoundingMode` runs right after `assertFixedWidth`. Its body is not shown in the visible diff. Tests expect a `TypeError` matching `/Expected roundingMode to be one of 'round', 'floor' or 'ceil'/` for `'trunc'`, `'halfExpand'`, `'ROUND'`, `''`, `null`, `1` and `true` [H7, H14].
- **Sign-aware mapping.** `toMagnitudeMode` converts the public mode into an `Intl` mode that acts on the magnitude [H4, H7]:
  - `round` → `halfExpand` [H4].
  - `floor` → `expand` if negative, else `trunc` [H4].
  - `ceil` → `trunc` if negative, else `expand` [H4].
  - `undefined` → `undefined` [H4].
- **Locale options.** `buildLocaleOptions` now receives `magnitudeMode` and sets `roundingMode: magnitudeMode ?? 'trunc'`. Omitting the option therefore keeps the old truncation when fraction digit options are set [H5, H6].
- **Carry onto the next unit.** On the fraction-digit path, when the mode is not `trunc` and a larger unit exists, the value is pre-rounded with `toLocaleString('en-US', {...localeOptions, useGrouping:false})`. If the result is `>= base`, the value moves up one unit, e.g. `999960` with `maximumFractionDigits: 1` → `1 MB` [H8, H3].
- **Default significant-digit path.** With no `localeOptions`, `undefined` and `halfExpand` keep `toPrecision`, so `1005` → `1 kB` stays as before. `expand` and `trunc` go to `roundToSignificantDigits`, which uses `maximumSignificantDigits` plus `roundingMode` and returns the number unchanged when `digits > 21` [H4, H8].
- **Bigint path.** `toUnrepresentableString` multiplies by `10n ** maximumFractionDigits` and divides by `scale` [H4, H9]:
  - It adds `1n` when the mode is `expand` and the remainder is `> 0n` [H4].
  - It adds `1n` when the mode is `halfExpand` and `remainder * 2n >= scale` [H4].
  - Previously this path always truncated [H4, E38].
- **Tests on the fraction-digit branch.** `1999` with `maximumFractionDigits: 1` gives `2 kB` (round), `1.9 kB` (floor) and `2 kB` (ceil). The same holds for `1999n`. Other cases are `1150`, `1101` and `-1005` → `-1.01 kB` [H14].
- **Tests on the default branch and sign handling.** `1001` with `ceil` → `1.01 kB` hits `roundToSignificantDigits` [H14, H8].
  - Explicit `'round'` is checked equal to omitted for `1337`, `1005`, `999_500` and others [H14].
  - `-0.04` with `ceil` → `-0 B` and with `floor` → `-0.1 B`, confirming the sign-dependent mapping [H14].
- **Test for the bigint branch.** It formats a huge bigint expected as `${whole} YB`. The full input is truncated in the evidence [H14].
- **Failures and verification** [E13, E14, E37, E38]:
  - The first run failed in "rounding up carries onto the next unit": actual `'999.96 kB'`, expected `'999.960 kB'`. The agent changed the test's expected value rather than the code [E13, E14].
  - Final runs: `node --test test-rounding.js` passed 11/11. The existing `test.js`, run through a scratchpad ava shim, gave 48 pass, 0 fail, 3 skipped [E37].
  - `tsd` and `xo` were not run [E38].
